functions.records.iter_records(root, entity, *, ki: Iterator of (native record, pathlib.Path); entity is one of the four native entities; optional kind is a direct filter.
functions.records.load_document(root, record_id): Read one native document and require its ID to match the filename.
functions.records.record_path(root, entity, record: Resolve the native path inside the repository.
functions.records.write_record_updates(root, updat: Upsert a mapping of entity names to complete native records; validate one complete candidate graph; install only changed files; return changed pathlib.Path values.
functions.records.install_candidate_updates(root,: Shared installation primitive with per-file atomic replacement, rollback for captured exceptions, and preserved candidate files; not a multi-file crash transaction.
functions.records.validate_corpus(root): Validate the current native graph, artifact bytes, references, snapshots and evidence; return native entity/kind/block counts or raise ValueError.
functions.schema_v3.validate_native(root): Return native validation error strings; an empty list means valid.
functions.records.block_text(document, block): Resolve exactly one Unicode codepoint range or literal.
functions.records.resolve_input_text(document, blo: Resolve inline observed input text or an exact, digest-checked input selector from an allowed source document.
functions.records.document_hash_input(document): Select the explicit native document content payload, preserving absent and null values.
functions.records.json_sha256(value): SHA-256 of compact canonical UTF-8 JSON; keys sorted, Unicode preserved, nonfinite numbers rejected.

items.membership: Collection members are ordered native members; their array position carries collection order.

documents.inputs: Ordered {role,target_id} edges; exactly one item owner; role and target-kind constraints are validated directly.
documents.blocks: Ordered blocks carry exactly one range:[start,end] or literal:string plus observed timing, source input, speaker and issue facts. Ranges use Unicode codepoints and exclusive ends.
documents.input_text_ref: {target_id,content_sha256,source,range}; source is text or blocks. text selects target.text; blocks selects the exact concatenation of block_text(target, block), with no separator. The digest is the native target document content payload hash.
documents.input_units: Independent observed input snapshot; source text, original times, quality and historical digest values remain unchanged.

assets.audio: Item ownership uses inputs role=item; downloads reference archive assets by archive_id and preserve release_tag and original ZIP member_path.
assets.artifacts: HTML and review documents reference exact local UTF-8 bytes by local_path, size_bytes and byte SHA-256. Independent assets are valid native facts.

annotations.targets: {role,target_id,order?}; role=item identifies ownership, applies_to states applicability, revision records actual adoption. Only revision targets carry zero-based order, unique and continuous within each revision document.
annotations.anchors: Stored paragraph_index refers to the native blocks array. Exact original/corrected text, paragraph text digests, excerpt, original time values and explicit review evidence are independently checked. Applicability, adoption, attribution and whole-document review are distinct facts.

hashes.document_payload_rule: Include exactly the listed fields that are present. Preserve the complete native inputs and blocks. Exclude record ID, metadata, quality and the digest itself. Transcript content_sha256 and all document input reference digests use json_sha256(document_hash_input(document)).
hashes.recognition_chunks: recognition_chunks_sha256 independently hashes the exact original recognition_chunks array.
hashes.record_cas: json_sha256 of the complete native record.
hashes.historical_observations: Digests inside immutable input snapshots and metadata source observations are historical facts, not current content caches. They are preserved exactly.

validation: Require the exact root schema declaration and all four native storage containers, including empty indexes and documents directory.
Reject duplicate IDs, duplicate JSON object keys, nonfinite JSON numbers, unknown structural fields and unresolved or wrong-kind references.
Validate same-item ownership, role cardinality, dependency cycles, exact input selectors and local artifact bytes.
Preserve unknown, false, null and absent quality states; derive current timestamp diagnostics without rewriting archived times or independent quality observations.
Never infer human confirmation, speaker attribution, silence or complete review from model results or missing content.
